name: Help Scout
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: Email-first shared inbox for support teams with live chat, social messaging, a knowledge base, workflows and an AI assistant that answers customer questions.
best_for: small and mid-sized support teams that want an email-first shared inbox with live chat and a help centre, priced per user without a minimum below Pro
skip_if: you run a large contact centre with native phone support, or you need SSO but have fewer than ten agents (SSO is on Pro, with a 10-user minimum)
honest_knock: The Free plan caps you at 100 contacts a month and one Inbox. Standard stops at 25 users and Plus at 50; Pro has a 10-user minimum and is sold through a demo. Extra Inboxes ($10) and Docs sites ($20) are charged monthly, AI Answers adds $0.75 per resolution, and SMS and phone run through integrations rather than natively. We have not used Help Scout ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Standard · per user per month billed yearly
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on helpscout.com/pricing with the monthly and annual toggles, USD) Free covers up to 5 users, 1 Inbox, 1 Docs site and 100 contacts a month, with 10 saved replies and 10 tags. A contact is someone who got a reply from your team or the AI assistant; several conversations with the same person count once. Standard is $25 per user a month billed annually or $30 monthly, for up to 25 users: 2 Inboxes, live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, multiple knowledge bases, one basic SLA policy, basic workflows, unlimited tags and saved replies and the AI Inbox assistant. Plus, marked popular, is $45 annually or $54 monthly, for up to 50 users: 5 Inboxes, advanced workflows, two advanced SLA policies, a secure customer portal, unlimited AI drafts, round-robin routing, Salesforce, Jira and HubSpot integrations and 25 light users. Pro is $75 annually or $90 monthly with unlimited users and a minimum of 10, sold through a demo: 10 Inboxes, unlimited workflows and SLAs, SSO/SAML, HIPAA compliance, 50 light users and a dedicated onboarding specialist. Extra Inboxes cost $10 a month and extra Docs sites $20 a month. AI Answers, the autonomous assistant, is an add-on at $0.75 per resolution billed monthly, with a 3-month free trial. Annual billing is labelled 16% off; SMS and phone calls run through integrations.

compare_with.name: Zendesk
compare_with.why: Zendesk is in our dossiers too and is the larger ticketing platform with more routing, reporting and add-ons. Help Scout keeps support closer to a shared email inbox, has a usable free plan for up to 5 users and fewer configuration layers.
